count_definition: Number of scored decision points with each observable predicate true, not events carrying private scenario family. Family counts overlap; unique positive count is a union.
dependence_requirements: Also record distinct subjects, episodes and units per family. Aim >=20 distinct subjects and >=30 distinct episode-or-background-time clusters per Validation/Final family, >=12 subjects and 20 clusters for Independent. Agent family objective is constrained by24/16 agents. Show concentration and cluster uncertainty;300 rows from one agent is not adequate.

family_recipe_design.A1: Combine acquisition/returning-customer mechanisms over 2..28d with regular-catchment probability U(0.2,0.9); changing activity by factor U(0.8,2.5). Cases may pass or fail multiple gates. Baseline is the actual ledger.
family_recipe_design.A2: Choose2..6 regular counterparties and allocate service shares U(0.35,0.90) over 2..24h; baseline concentration may already be high.
family_recipe_design.A3: 5..16 services over 0.25..3h to 2..8 wallets; bursts can span the 1h boundary; activity count baseline uses preceding28d.
family_recipe_design.A4: Mixed cash services over 2..24h,2..8 wallets, cash-out probability U(0.1,0.9), common amount sampling with direction multiplier U(0.5,2); no accept-until-A4 loop.
family_recipe_design.N1: 4..12 incoming W2W edges,2..8 senders, over 1..24h; use shared amounts and existing relation history.
family_recipe_design.N2: 4..12 outgoing W2W edges,2..8 receivers, over 1..24h; same relation and value support as H5.
family_recipe_design.N3: Propose simple walks2..6 vertices and return edges, chronology jitter and independent amounts with multiplicative factors exp(U(log0.15,log5)); include reversed-order and competing paths. Do not call evaluator to choose any qualifying path.
family_recipe_design.N4: Incoming W2W funding and subsequent mixed outward events over 1..24h; proposed outward fraction U(0.1,1.2); accounting rejection is separate and logged.
family_recipe_design.S1: 4..12 subject events across5..60min; value dispersion from a common Dirichlet(1,1,...) allocation; total amount sampled from shared value process; both dominant and diffuse payments possible.
family_recipe_design.S2: 4..12 subject payments over 1..7d; base amount from shared process, multiplicative jitter lognormal log-SD U(0.01,0.15); interleave unrelated payments. Use adequate background activity without searching evaluated target.
family_recipe_design.S3: 6..16 subject events over 3..20h with independent inter-arrival jitter, across3..8 proposed occupied hours; may cross UTC midnight. Full daily counts remain causal.
family_recipe_design.S4: 5..12 payments over 1..7d; recipe amounts drawn continuous USD 5000..13000, with common cent rounding; earlier same-profile large-payment history may defeat rate change. No forced positive label.

holdout_support: Later sealed custodian runs fixed support/schema/causality gates and releases only a predeclared pass/fail certificate before model freeze, not detailed rows/counts. Failed seals are quarantined without exposing outcomes to developers; no seed shopping. Any replacement requires versioned authorization and no cross-version benchmark claim.
no_retry: One production draw per frozen manifest and seed. No repeat generation until prevalence, support, AUC, overlap or model performance looks preferable. Shortfalls are retained and documented.

opportunity_budget.family_allocation: S2,S4,N3 weight2 each, all other families weight1. Allocate2000 event opportunities by largest-remainder rounding in code order; includes preparatory/pre-onset events. This is not target balancing.
opportunity_budget.hard_allocation: H1..H8 weights1 each; largest-remainder rounding with lexical ties; event provenance assigned once.
opportunity_budget.warmup_per_unit: 1200 background-only opportunities; labels can still emerge from observable behaviour.

opportunity_recipe: Event budgets allocated before targets. Episode sizes are discrete uniform8..20 conditioned only on completing the budget, with any residual<8 assigned to background and reported. Continuous start times uniform over fitting intervals; no forced30d blocks. Same episode-size law for positive-intended and hard origins. Strength U(0.1,0.9), never label input.
range_justification: Broad enriched research coverage envelope:12 families at 300 positives in15000 rows could require up to 24% unique positives absent overlap.10-45% leaves overlap and routine/hard-origin positives possible; not an estimate of operational prevalence.
shortfall_resolution: Block training or qualified family-performance claims when development coverage is inadequate. Before any model evaluation, either approve a new version with scientifically justified opportunity changes, or retain the frozen population benchmark and authorize a separately labeled family challenge set with cluster uncertainty. Do not mix challenge-set prevalence into the 100k benchmark. If realistic S4 support is infeasible, report imprecise S4 recall and a separate stress test; do not distort ordinary amounts to claim coverage.
status: DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and population evidence pending
support_rationale: Several hundred rows can stabilize raw recall relative to V3 counts1 and 8. An independent-binomial worst-case95% half-width is about 0.057 atN300; event dependence makes this optimistic. No achieved count or precision claim before generation.
